description: dot with a[i]/b[i] is ~1.25x plain C (0.79 vs 0.62 ns/elem); sum via 'x <- a' generator has no checks and matches C. Add range analysis in Defk.Compiler: for 'i <- 0..(n - 1)//1' where n is len(a) or min(len(a), ...), emit unchecked a.data[i]. Done when dot is within ~5% of C and out-of-range indexes still raise Enum.OutOfBoundsError.
title: Bounds-check elimination for provably in-range a[i]
